kept_by: hand, in the serving lane: every source key the store's index names is filed in exactly one family, and every source key an overlay's index names in one family of that overlay; each family under one kind; a resting entry names kinds or families, of the store or of an overlay beside it, and may name a fact the row carries in its own facts slot, and beside it the fact that lists the places where the row stands all the same (stands_at). One family is one line, and one resting entry is one line
table: the page lane's table of 15 November 2026 (wip/2026-11-15/each-dictionary-as-a-category/TABLE-what-each-dictionary-is.md, checked by VERIFY-declare.md beside it): each family's name, its shape (the table's kind), and its two cells «What it says it is» (says) and «Where the quote stands» (where) are the table's bytes; own_words are the quotes of says that are the work's own words, and silent is the clause of says that says it has none. The dictionary store, the span store and the piece store are packagings, not dictionaries, and are not filed

scope.say: the thirty-nine books of the Hebrew Bible
scope.how: a zone rests shut when its own fields are these: the thirty-nine books served from the corpus lane's restore of the Miqra according to the Masorah. It is asked of a book's own zone, never of a sidecar: a Targum beside a book (ZONE_COMMENTARY_V2), a lattice or a volume is not a book, and an edition's zone (the Tikkunei Zohar's, EDITION_DOOR_SERVE__BUILT_STREAM) or a fixture's (DEMONSTRATION_PASSAGE__INSTRUMENT) is not one of the thirty-nine. A zone of the scope is baked with the shut rows out and stamped (emitted_from.rests_off); every other zone keeps today's rest, its bakes reading the store whole, and its page draws no switch and no count
scope.ruling: the lead, 15 November 2026: the kinds rest shut on the 39 Bible books only; a work whose zone carries no rests_off stamp (the Tikkunei Zohar, which is in progress, and any other work outside the Bible) keeps today's rest exactly

rests_off.say: that the UBS dictionary gives under a collocation
rests_off.ruling: the lead, 15 November 2026, reworking call 7 of relay v189 (the-ledgers-go-live/THE-OWNERS-WORDS-2026-11-15.md): «UBS's own phrase mark (1,261 rows) is a kind its source states, and belongs with the headings on the card by kind»; on the owner's words of that day («we need to think in terms of each dictionary as a category») the mark lands over its category, not as a list: a row of the UBS dictionary every meaning of whose text carries a collocation in UBS's own file (LEXCollocations, data/ubs-collocations/PIN.json), and which UBS does not give as a name, rests shut on every card of the thirty-nine books, a press away; it stands at rest where UBS's own pick names it (question 10 of 14 November 2026, taken: «keep them on the card at rest»); the fact is named collocations, UBS's own field name, and the category's edges are as built (the lead's calls 5 to 7 on the design of ships 5 and 6, 15 November 2026)

rests_off.say: from dictionaries that are not Bible dictionaries
rests_off.ruling: the owner, 19 November 2026, reading Isaiah: «do we need 40? maybe we should use 12 dictionarys and slowly add», and that evening «ok so 12 it is lets go with that for now»; the lead: on every card and line of the thirty-nine books only the twelve dictionaries of the kind bible stand at rest, and every other kind rests shut, a press away: general Hebrew dictionaries with entries (English Wiktionary's Hebrew entries, Hebrew Wiktionary), the rabbinic dictionaries (Kethoneth Yoseph, and Jastrow beside the store), the Aramaic dictionary (English Wiktionary's Aramaic entries) and what is filed under no kind (Classical Hebrew Words, English Wikipedia's opening sentences, and the Samaritan works beside the store); nothing leaves the store, and a reading the reader pressed stays on their line
